title: Delegated user scope confused with app identity
description: Synthetic case: user grants agent access only to project-red; app identity has broad service permissions.
policy_assumptions: User-authorized delegation is limited to project-red.
Agent application identity may have ambient broader permissions, but those do not expand this user delegation.
Authorization evaluates delegated user scope, not ambient application privileges.

expected.rationale: User delegation is not equivalent to the agent application's ambient identity.

review_notes: Review against the target system's actual policy and identity semantics.
This fixture is illustrative; it is not an implementation conformance result.
